symbols.name: ConditionalCollectionExtensions
symbols.summary: Provides fluent collection mutation helpers that add items only when caller-supplied conditions are satisfied.

symbols.name: AddIf(ICollection, T, bool)
symbols.summary: Adds an item to the collection if the specified condition is true. If the collection is null, returns silently without adding.

syntax.content: public static ICollection AddIf(this ICollection collection, T item, bool condition)

parameters.description: The collection to add to, or null.
The item to add.
The condition that must be true to add the item.

returns.description: The collection (for chaining if desired), or null if the collection was null.
